compliance_items.item: Ethics approval stated with approving body, approval number and scope

evidence.quote: The study was approved by the institutional ethics board.

compliance_items.recommendation: Add the ethics approval number and the approved scope; name the board.

compliance_items.item: Informed consent obtained from human participants and stated
compliance_items.reason: No consent statement appears anywhere in the provided manuscript text; cannot determine whether consent was obtained.
compliance_items.recommendation: Authors to state informed-consent procedure; reviewer to re-check once provided.

evidence.quote: The authors declare no conflicts of interest.

compliance_items.item: Data availability statement with a concrete access route

evidence.quote: Data are available from the corresponding author on reasonable request.

missing: repository name or accession/DOI for the trial data
compliance_items.recommendation: Deposit de-identified data in a repository and cite the accession; keep the request route as fallback.

missing: individual contribution description for each author
compliance_items.recommendation: Add a CRediT-style per-author contributions section.

compliance_items.item: Adapted/reproduced third-party figures carry source AND permission/license

evidence.quote: Figure 2 was adapted from Smith et al. (2021).

missing: permission or license statement for the adapted figure
full source citation with license type
compliance_items.recommendation: Obtain and state permission/license for Figure 2, or replace it with an original figure.

compliance_items.item: Trial registration number and registry name reported
compliance_items.recommendation: Register the trial (retrospectively if needed) and report registry + ID; explain the registration timing per CONSORT.

compliance_items.item: Participant flow diagram/numbers through each stage
compliance_items.reason: Only enrollment (60 patients) is stated; no flow diagram or stage numbers are present in the provided text, and figures cannot be read.
compliance_items.recommendation: Provide the CONSORT flow diagram with numbers screened, allocated, followed up and analyzed.
